Context: 3. Separate Pool for certain categories of employees

Automatic transfer of Type 'VI-B'(C-1) Secretaries Pool (SG). Type 'VI-B' (C-1) accommodations remaining unallotted for two months, in Secretaries Pool (SG) will be transferred to General Pool in Automated System of allotment before the last day of each month. GIO (2), Rule 30.
